locations.note: The player is called to Easter Island, where the Professor's abandoned camp and a cave hold the Timegate.
A portal leads into an Ancient Egyptian temple complex, one of the lost civilizations the player visits.
A portal leads to a Maya jungle city, one of the lost civilizations the player visits.
The Anasazi cliff dwellings of the American Southwest form another time-portal world.
After collecting the three civilization gene pods, the player explores the fifth area, the lost city of Atlantis, placed where Plato put it: beyond the Pillars of Heracles, out in the Atlantic.
